name: Spellcasting Mastery
body:
You are quick and certain in your movements when casting spells.

Prerequisite(s) Ability to cast spells or use spell-like abilities, Spellcraft 3 ranks.

Benefit(s) You can take 10 on caster level checks (as though it were a skill check). This does not allow you to take 20.
